name: Stranglethorn arena: the Arena Master trinket starts Arena Master (#12016)
contract: Quest 7810 'Arena Master' names item 18706 'Arena Master' as its StartItem and has no other starter; 7838 'Arena Grandmaster' requires 7810 (PrevQuestID).
Stock 3.3.5 data and Wowhead classic list item 18706 as 'This Item Begins a Quest' for 7810. With item_template.startquest 0 the trinket offers nothing, so 7810 and the 7838 chain cannot be started.
Accepting 7810 from the carried trinket (CMSG_QUESTGIVER_ACCEPT_QUEST, 393, with the item as quest giver) must put 7810 in the log. It has no objectives, so its status is complete (1).

steps.label: SETUP: the trinket is carried and 7810 is not in the log
Accept Arena Master from the trinket
Arena Master is in the log and complete
